posts.text:
Mamdani plans to close one of America's most notorious and violent jails.


Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani (@NYCMayor)

We just took another major step toward finally closing Rikers Island. 

By permanently closing a jail and transferring three properties to DCAS, we're moving closer to closing Rikers for good. 

Our City's resources should be invested in rehabilitation, restoration, and a smaller, more humane jail system.



— https://nitter.net/NYCMayor/status/2072072394663919686#m
